geometry.note: Not a physical structure; drawn and labelled as an inferred direction only, per contract rules. The NuMI beam also served the MINOS far detector at Soudan (1985-2016) on a nearly identical bearing (336.2 degrees vs 335.6 degrees here, both computed from the same near point) -- not drawn separately to avoid clutter; see the worklog for the Soudan distance/bearing. Second pass (2026-09-18): near point upgraded from the coarse 3 km Fermilab campus point to the derived NuMI target (geometry:fermilab-numi-target, OSM-anchored, accuracy_m 30), which also makes this line start exactly where geometry:fermilab-numi-beamline ends.

method: Great-circle bearing (335.6 degrees) from the derived NuMI target (geometry:fermilab-numi-target) to the sourced Ash River far-site coordinate (site:ash-river-nova-far-detector, 48.4,-92.8), clipped to the first 3000 m so it stays within the map extent (map extent_m 2500).
